# Leader Shield Funding

> Leader Shield Funding is a network marketing platform for Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) lending and recurring subscription products. Agents earn multi-tiered commissions by referring merchants and recruiting new agents via binary tree hierarchy.
> URL: https://leadershieldfunding.com

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://leadershieldfunding.com/): Main marketing and recruitment landing page with full compensation plan details, income lifestyle scenarios, and agent sign-up CTA.
- [Income Disclosure](https://leadershieldfunding.com/income-disclosure): FTC-compliant earnings disclosure for prospective agents.
- [Terms of Service](https://leadershieldfunding.com/terms): Platform terms and conditions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://leadershieldfunding.com/privacy): Data collection and privacy practices.
- [Refund Policy](https://leadershieldfunding.com/refund-policy): Subscription and service refund terms.

## Campaign Pages

- [MCA for Declined Merchants](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/declined): Landing page for merchants who were declined by traditional banks.
- [MCA for Debt Consolidation](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/consolidation): Landing page for merchants seeking to consolidate existing advances.
- [Growth Capital](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/growth): Landing page for merchants seeking growth capital.
- [Seasonal Funding](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/seasonal): Landing page for merchants with seasonal cash flow needs.
- [For Partners & ISOs](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/partners): Partner and call center ISO recruitment page.
- [Agent Referral Program](https://leadershieldfunding.com/lp/referral): Agent referral and recruitment landing page.

## Products

- **Merchant Cash Advance (MCA):** Capital access for merchants with commissions earned by agents on funded deals via GBR waterfall.
- **Merchant Growth Platform — Tier 1 (Starter, $149/mo):** 750 verified lead credits/mo, 5 email outreach sequences, Basic AI Brand Intelligence, integrates with existing CRM. Powered by Lead Titan AI.
- **Merchant Growth Platform — Tier 2 (Growth Foundation, $397/mo):** Advanced AI Brand Intelligence, native AI CRM (1,000 contacts + scoring), 24/7 AI chatbot lead capture, AI visual email, performance dashboard.
- **Merchant Growth Platform — Tier 3 (Revenue Growth System, $697/mo, Most Popular):** Everything in Growth Foundation plus 2,000 lead credits/mo, Darwin AI Chief of Staff, AI social content to Meta, Ask AI, CRM 10,000 contacts + automation.
- **Merchant Growth Platform — Tier 4 (Revenue Scale AI, $1,497/mo, Best Value):** Everything in Revenue Growth System plus AI Caller (750 outbound min/mo), AI paid ads + ad designer + insights, social to Meta/LinkedIn/X, AI blogs, CRM 25,000 contacts + advanced automation. Powered by Marketing Titan + Lead Titan AI.

## Agent Sign-Up

- [Sign Up](https://leadershieldfunding.com/signup): Create a new agent account (referral code required or sponsor search available).
- [Login](https://leadershieldfunding.com/login): Existing agent login.
